context: Hina-young tries her first part-time job at the ramen shop; Naoko coaches.
purpose: Aunt guiding teen through first workday lessons.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright opening, almost a yelp of anxiety. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Slightly higher pitch — seeking reassurance. Warm but genuinely worried.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Brassy Kansai lilt with a tap of authority. Sharp, bright attack on the opening. Teaching tone without condescension — she's done this a hundred times. Firm but affectionate.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'll be careful and do my best!
lines.style: Determined small voice. Slow, deliberate pace — she's making a promise to herself and to Auntie. Earnest, no irony. Slight nervous energy underneath the commitment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: That's the spirit! That's what I like to see!
lines.style: Loud, animated Kansai warmth. Punchy emphasis on the affirmation. Laughing energy underneath — genuinely proud. The kind of aunt who fills a room without trying.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、おばちゃん、ありがと!
lines.style: Bright, relieved exhale. Quick and genuine. Warmth rising toward her — the anxiety settling because she's been grounded by someone who believes in her. Small, sincere gratitude.
